concept: Step Functions: orchestrate Lambda with branching, retries, error handling
tests: Choosing a service for visual orchestration of multiple Lambdas with branching and retries.
expected: AWS Step Functions — state machine with built-in Choice, Retry, Catch and visualization. Triggers: "coordinate multiple Lambda functions", "branching logic, retries, error handling", "visual".
why_not: SQS and SNS — messaging, not orchestration; AWS Batch — batch computing without a state machine.
